name: Suruga Maki
source: Maki is the middle sister. She is bubbly and full of energy. Maki goes to college with her boyfriend, Ippei Takebayashi and a foreign exchange student, Chamsi "Cham" Benenetty. Maki is the top player of the tennis team. The three sisters and their arch-rival, Alice Kagurazaka, are on the tennis team. The storyline progresses through the game as Maki deals with her college life.
